faq.question: Is this Karpagam College of Engineering?
faq.answer: This page concerns Karpagam Academy of Higher Education, the deemed university in Eachanari, Coimbatore. Karpagam College of Engineering and Karpagam Institute of Technology are separately named institutions; their courses and calendars must be checked separately.

faq.question: Are the computing science degrees three or four years?
faq.answer: Current 2026–27 FASCM regulations use a four-year honours structure. They also allow a bachelor exit after three years. Honours with Research has additional marks and research-credit conditions; ask for the exact award recorded at your chosen exit.

faq.question: What does the July intake label mean?
faq.answer: It records historical first-year induction in July 2026:2 July for computing BSc/BCA streams and 23 July for BE/BTech. These reports do not establish the next application deadline or the first teaching day. Obtain the next cohort notice directly.

faq.question: Are engineering annual fees confirmed tuition?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 engineering schedule labels its figures annual fee and gives mark-band charges. It does not identify a separate tuition component, so tuition is on request. Ask for a component-wise quotation and the charge applicable to your marks and admission category.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: KAHE invites international applicants through its international-admissions route. Individual programme eligibility, equivalence, entrance conditions, foreign/NRI fees and visa suitability still need confirmation. The route details here do not constitute a confirmed overseas offer.

faq.question: Is the published fee a complete living budget?
faq.answer: No. Programme fee notes distinguish tuition or annual charges from one-time admission and health charges. Hostel, mess, transport and other personal costs need separate quotations. A fee for one academic year does not guarantee the same charge in later years.

faq.question: Are all current university programmes listed here?
faq.answer: This page lists 33 verified own-campus routes. Exact academic qualification and degree structure are checked; unknown first-entry dates do not prevent an otherwise supported listing. Other programmes remain held for actual qualification, professional-scope or campus-identity verification, rather than optional date or language evidence alone.

faq.question: What should applicants check before paying?
faq.answer: Confirm the exact official award, full-time or lateral route, qualification acceptance, admission category, next cohort dates and itemised fee. Residential applicants should also confirm room availability and mess terms. Admission and employment outcomes are not guaranteed.

faq.question: Which additional academic degrees are included?
faq.answer: The expanded portfolio includes eight Commerce Honours specialisations, Biotechnology and Microbiology Honours, MCom and five MSc routes in Computer Science, Chemistry, Physics, Biotechnology and Microbiology. Exact entry subjects and qualifying degrees apply; unresolved professional and qualification-conflict routes remain separate.

faq.question: Do four-year Honours degrees have a three-year exit?
faq.answer: Current 2026–27 regulations allow a bachelor degree after six semesters and an Honours award after eight semesters. Honours with Research requires the specified marks and research credits; it is not automatic. These pathways are represented within the exact degree rather than duplicated as separately admitting awards.

faq.question: Are the newly added academic degrees taught in English?
faq.answer: The applicable 2026–27 faculty regulations explicitly specify English instruction and examinations, including seminar presentations and project/thesis/dissertation reports. Confirm any individual support arrangements with the university.

faq.question: What is known about the new academic fees and start months?
faq.answer: Exact 2026–27 semester tuition is available for fifteen of the sixteen additions, with admission and health charges additional. Fin Tech requires a separate quote. No verified first-entry month is assigned to these additions; earlier engineering or computing induction reports do not establish their start dates.
